lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in approximately five staggered vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the primary circular spots, creating a grid-like alignment on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.
